svg.text: Project Circle · level layout proposal v0.3 · follows the story flow · schematic, not to scale · names and bosses are proposals

g.text: needs the Triangle Mould (come back later)
needs Vertex Seals I and II
1 The Outskirts — start, by the circle's home. Three
triangles mock it; seen from its eyes; blackout.
2 Discard Pit — wakes up hurt. Movement only.
3 Old Triangle's Hollow — first Mirror. The world
shakes; he warns of the entity, opens the gateway.
4 Hall of Strings — the cape forms: + BLADE (and pogo).
5 Broken Vertex Graveyard — first fights. At the end
a string joins the cape: + DASH.
6 Scalene Slums — corrupted village. Where they stood
together: + PARRY. Mirror before the boss.
7 BOSS 1 · The Base Warden — Vertex Seal I and a new
cape string: + DOUBLE JUMP. (Does not free the Slums.)
8 Isosceles Terraces — climb the middle ranks.
9 BOSS 2 · The Twin Isosceles — duo. Vertex Seal II.
10 Equilateral Spire — needs Seals I + II. Last Mirror.
12 Temple of Three Points — the Triangle Mould:
become a triangle for a while; the Madness Bar fills.
13 Road to the Square Realm — exit, next world.
Rank Gate (M) — lets only triangles through: return with
the Mould and pass as one. Opens the Prism Caverns
and the Refractor (optional boss, a late reward).
Whispering Fissure (D) — corruption zone; late game
Hall of Measure — where triangles are ranked. Lore.
Square's Refuge (J) — the Square, hidden. Ally.
Shrine of the First Break (M) — under the Graveyard.
Abilities and the enemies they answer
Blade + pogo (Hall of Strings) — chasers, Spires,
Swarm Shards (dash out of the dive).
Parry (Slums) — Ceiling Sentries, orb casters, laser
Double jump (Warden) — the Overseer on its perch,
flyers, the Terraces climb, the Square's Refuge.
An enemy only appears after the ability that answers it.
• Rank = height. The circle starts at the very bottom
and climbs the hierarchy that threw it away.
• Each string is another cast-out shape's resistance:
the cape grows as the circle gains allies.
• Each freed village becomes an ally and weakens
the Shapeshifter's hold on the region.
• The Mould opens what rank kept closed (Rank Gate,
M gates): a reason to come back to old places.
Built in the prototype: Outskirts → Pit → Hollow → Hall of
Strings (StoryTest), the Base Warden (BossArena), and all
